description: Share one of your Switch Editor projects with a team member by their Switch account email, stop sharing it, or list who has it. A shared project opens for them with its media, its chat history and its renders; they can edit, upload, run the editor brains and render. Only the owner can share or delete. Actions: share (default), unshare, list.

email.description: The team member's Switch account email. Required for share and unshare.

name: share_editor_project
title: Share Editor Project
